ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “Trophic level”. On the left is “A terrestrial food chain”, labeled from bottom to top as Plant, Grasshopper, Mouse, Snake, Hawk, and connected with upward arrows. Reasoning: In a food chain, the plants at the bottom level can make their own food through photosynthesis and provide energy for upper-level consumers, so the role of plants in a terrestrial food chain is producers.
